name: Deep Research
description: Multi-source web research that writes a long cited report into this workspace's documents, taking several minutes. Only when the user asks for research, a report, or a review that needs many sources; for quick facts or news, use web search.
author: anything

input.hint: Model that plans, checks for gaps, writes and fact-checks: glm-* runs on Z.AI, anything else on DeepSeek.
Model for the parallel search-and-read workers, run with thinking off (so a DeepSeek model: glm-5.3 can't turn thinking off).
DeepSeek model the planner switches to for the rest of a run when Z.AI says the GLM plan's usage is spent (429 or 1113); 'off' lets the run go on without it.

examples.prompt: Do deep research on how heat pumps perform in Nordic winters
examples.call: {"question": "How do air-source heat pumps perform in Nordic winters: efficiency at low temperatures, real-world field data, and costs compared with alternatives?", "depth": "standard"}

examples.prompt: Write me a quick research report comparing Zola, Hugo and Eleventy
examples.call: {"question": "How do the static site generators Zola, Hugo and Eleventy compare in features, performance, templating and ecosystem?", "depth": "quick"}

examples.prompt: Research how the EU, the US and China regulate AI, one section each
examples.call: {"question": "How do the EU, the US and China regulate AI as of 2026: the main laws, what they require of developers, and how they're enforced?", "depth": "standard", "sub_questions": ["The EU AI Act: obligations by risk class, timelines and enforcement", "US federal and state AI rules and executive orders in force in 2026", "China's AI regulations: generative AI measures, algorithm registry and enforcement"], "title": "AI regulation in the EU, the US and China (2026)"}

question.description: The research question, self-contained: scope, time frame and what to compare (the researchers can't see the chat).

depth.description: "quick" (a few minutes, only when asked for fast), "standard" (default, 5-10 min) or "thorough" (10-20 min, only when asked for thorough).

sub_questions.description: Optional: your split of the question, each a goal or {"goal": "...", "queries": ["..."]}; at most quick 3, standard 5, thorough 8.

title.description: Optional, with sub_questions: the report's title, at most 120 characters.
